visualCharacteristics.summary: Square solid-colour tiles in a 3-column grid; colour name and Hex/RGB/CMYK/PMS values bottom-left; Copy HEX pill top-right; optional texture image fill
visualCharacteristics.purpose: colour palette swatches painted from their Hex value with a Copy HEX control

contentPattern.summary: 6 colour swatch tiles with Hex/RGB/CMYK/PMS and Copy HEX | 3 swatch tiles: Navy Blue, Royal Blue, Special Finish (texture image, name only) | 3 swatch tiles: White, Black, Ruby Red | sub-brand-guide: 5 swatches: Navy Blue, Royal Blue, Process Blue, Bright Blue, Lime | 5 swatches: Golden Hour, Mint, Pink Lemonade, Watermelon, Purple Sunset
contentPattern.structure: one row per swatch; cell 1 optional texture image (leave empty for flat colours); cell 2 colour name as h3, then paragraphs "Hex: 0091D2", "RGB: 0/145/210", "CMYK: 100/15/0/0", "Pms: Process Blue C/U" (omit values for special-finish tiles)

usage: Colour palette grids. One row per swatch: optional texture image cell, then a text cell with the colour name (h3) and "Hex:", "RGB:", "CMYK:", "Pms:" paragraphs. The tile is painted from the Hex value, text switches light/dark by luminance, and a "Copy HEX" button copies the hex. Leave values out (name only) and add an image for special-finish tiles. Works for 3-6 tiles.
reuseGuidance: Any palette/swatch grid on guideline chapters (colour, sub-brand core palettes)

blockContent.source: get_block_examples /block-collection/cards (2-column model: image cell + text cell)

cells: Cell 1 (image, optional): texture image for special-finish tiles (e.g. Special Finish foil); empty for flat colours
Cell 2 (text): colour name as heading (h3), then one paragraph per value as 'Hex: 0091D2', 'RGB: 0/145/210', 'CMYK: 100/15/0/0', 'Pms: Process Blue C/U'

blockContent.behaviour: Block code reads the Hex value to paint the tile, chooses light/dark text by luminance, and adds the 'Copy HEX' copy-to-clipboard control. Tiles without values (Special Finish) show only the name over the image.
